frozen_key.terminology: UC-042 case statuses are CLEAN / EXCEPTIONS_OPEN / EVIDENCE_INCOMPLETE. INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE is a per-control outcome; any INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE result makes the case EVIDENCE_INCOMPLETE (uc042lib.validate.case_status).
frozen_key.not_predicted: PASS and NOT_APPLICABLE totals and engine-assigned exception / group IDs are recorded from the run, not predicted (they depend on engine internals, not on the scenario design).
frozen_key.basis: Derived by tools/build_scenarios.py from the scenario design (planted record operations) and the generated records, using the UC-042 control semantics already verified on the Jan-Aug 2026 packs (same discrepancy kinds). Written before any engine run; no engine output was read.
